text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's great. I can tell I'm getting
stronger. But...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But this won't stop me! The legend of
Teio is still
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll fly higher and higher, getting
stronger and
stronger from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She still feels so far away. No matter how
hard I
try, it doesn't even seem like I'm
getting any
closer to...
